QuestInfo.name: To Vieren
QuestInfo.1: Vieren is looking for you.\r\n#b(Meet Vieren in the lobby.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You agreed to help with the White Mage's research and asked Vieren how you can help.

0.0: Hey, mercenary. I hear you're helping with the research. Are you a minion of the White Mage now? Hee hee. Anyway, Vieren's been looking for you.

yes.0: I don't know if I can trust the White Mage. Always using big words, always cooped up in the lab. He's just kind of creepy.\r\n#b(Go to Vieren in the Lobby.)#k

no.0: Don't you think you should go see him?

1.0: Ah, hello. Are you here to help with the Master's research?

yes.0: You know who I am, right? #bVieren#k, the lowest-ranking magician of Aurora. Hey, nowhere to go but up, right? Ha ha.

npc.0: Vieren is looking for you. Time to play with the White Mage, I guess. \r\n#b(Talk to Vieren in the lobby.)#k
